project.name: Clan Cup
project.description: Clan Cup is a weekly tournament for clans in a card game. Clans sign up during the week, play a single-elimination bracket of 8 or 16 clans over the weekend, and the winner's crest shows on the clan list until the next cup.

tasks.text: Write the Clan Cup rules page
tasks.description:
Write the one-page rules for Clan Cup: sign-up, bracket size, match windows, no-shows, and ties.
Why: the server team cannot size scheduling, and community cannot announce, until the rules are fixed.
Done when: the rules page exists in the design docs space and answers what happens when a clan misses its window.
Where: the design docs space, under Clan Cup.
Notes: brackets are 8 or 16 clans, single elimination, 12-hour windows; do not add a loser bracket.

tasks.text: Sketch the sign-up and bracket screens
tasks.description:
Sketch the two screens players see: the sign-up card on the clan page and the bracket view.
Why: these are the only new screens, and the server team needs them to know which data to return.
Done when: both sketches are in the design file, each state covered: open, full, closed, playing, finished.
Where: the Clan Cup page in the design file.
Notes: reuse the existing clan page card style; no new components.

tasks.text: Review the rules and sketches with the server team
tasks.description:
Walk the server team through the rules page and the two sketches, and settle what their side returns.
Why: scheduling and results are the risky part, and changing rules after they start costs a week.
Done when: the team agrees in writing on the data each screen needs, and open questions are listed on the rules page.
Where: the rules page and the design file.

milestones.name: First cup runs on the test server

tasks.text: Hand the finished screens to development
tasks.description:
Finish the sign-up and bracket screens from the agreed sketches and hand them off.
Why: development starts from these.
Done when: final screens and their states are marked ready in the design file, with text in both languages.
Where: the Clan Cup page in the design file.
Notes: keep the text short enough for the Arabic version to fit the same cards.

tasks.text: Run a test cup with 8 internal clans
tasks.description:
Run one full Clan Cup on the test server with 8 internal clans, from sign-up to the crest showing.
Why: the first real run finds the scheduling holes before players do.
Done when: a full bracket finishes, the winner's crest shows for a week, and every problem is logged as a task.
Where: the test server; the internal clans list is with the community team.
Notes: include one forced no-show to check that rule.

Write the announcement for the first public Clan Cup: what it is, how to sign up, and the dates.
Why: sign-ups close Thursday, so players need to know early in the week.
Done when: the text is approved and scheduled with community.
Where: community's announcement queue.
Notes: link the rules page; keep it to three short paragraphs.

tasks.text: Watch the first live cup and log what breaks
tasks.description:
Follow the first live cup from sign-up to crest, and log every problem players hit.
Why: the first weekend decides whether clans come back.
Done when: the cup finishes and a list of fixes, each as a task, is added to this project.
Where: the live clan list and the community channels.

ideas.title: Idea: a season of cups
ideas.text: Points from each week's placement add up to a monthly season champion. Worth it only if weekly sign-ups stay above 16 clans.

ideas.title: Idea: spectator view
ideas.text: Let clan members watch their clan's match live. Needs the replay work first, so not before the second quarter.
